units: 1 unit = 1 game tile; +Y up; origin = base centre on the ground (y=0); front faces +Z

conventions.vertexColors: COLOR_0 = baked soft AO / moss / foliage shading; multiply into base colour (material.vertexColors = true)
conventions.sway: materials named 'leaves*' or 'cloth_*' are wind-driven; per-vertex weight in attribute _SWAY (three.js: geometry.attributes._sway), 0 = rigid, 1 = free
conventions.emissive: materials named 'emissive_*' glow (emissiveFactor / emissiveTexture) -> bloom layer
conventions.alpha: leaves / cloth_banner use alphaMode MASK (alphaTest 0.5), double sided
conventions.light: optional [x, y, z] (glTF axes, model space) where the engine should place a flame/light; lightColor = suggested light colour
conventions.lights: optional list of every light anchor ([x, y, z] each) for props with several flames (Helheim set pieces); `light` is always the first / main one
conventions.marker: optional [x, y, z] anchor for a floating quest marker (clear space above the prop)
conventions.lod1: id of a lower-detail version (<id>_lod1.glb, same materials/textures, ~1/2 the leaf-card fill = leafArea); LOD entries carry lodOf
conventions.map: world-2 kits: map id the prop belongs to; kind = tree|rock|decor|building|setpiece|light|wall|pillar|walkway|edge (trees with a map prefix are still kind 'tree': use it instead of the id prefix for Lambert/occluder choices)
conventions.kits: optional texture-sharing packs: kit_<name>.glb holds every model of the family as a root node named by its id; each texture is stored once. The per-id .glb files stay complete and self-contained.

Set piece: Gjallarbru, the golden bridge over Gjoll, 3 wide x 10 long (runs along glTF Z). Tarnished gold deck plates (walk lane |x| <= 1.1) arching from y=0.12 at the ends to 0.5 in the middle: deck_y(z) = 0.12 + 0.38 * (1 - (z/5)^2). Gold railings (blocking at |x| ~ 1.27), stone piers, four portals with gold-shingled gable roofs, skulls with soul-fire eyes and soul lanterns (emissive_soul) on the end gates, Hel banners (cloth_tatters sway) on the mid frames.

Gjoll river corner, 1 tile: ice only in the +X/-Z quadrant (rounded), bank elsewhere - the outside of a bend. At rotation 0 its +X border continues a rot-0 edge (bank +Z) and its -Z border continues a rot -pi/2 edge (bank -X). All Gjoll pieces share one border cross-section (the lip crosses every tile border at its midpoint) and seamless periodic textures, so edge, edge_b, the two corners and ice fit together in any 90-degree rotation. Rotation (three.js rotation.y) of a straight edge: 0 = bank toward +Z (south bank), pi = bank toward -Z (north bank), +pi/2 = bank toward +X, -pi/2 = bank toward -X. PLACEMENT: the pieces are flat (ice at y=0.02, bank easing to y=0 at its outer border, 0.3 skirts below). Lay every tile of one river reach at ONE common height (decor `y0`, at least the highest terrain corner under the reach), not at each tile's own ground height: on sloped terrain the ground (and its SURF.ICE paint) otherwise pierces the flat tiles along the terrain triangles - the black/white harlequin of graphics round 5.

Set piece: Eljudnir, Hel's hall, 8 wide x 6 deep, ridge 6.5 (horn finials to 8). Rotten board walls and sagging roof with holes where bone rafters show, a vertebra ridge, a tusk-arch around the great door (dark, faint green glow deep inside: emissive_soul_dim), Hel's round soul-eye in the gable, green windows, skull row, bone-legged soul braziers (emissive_soul) and Hel banners (cloth_tatters sway) at the front. Door threshold at glTF z=+2.0, y=0.4 (steps down to z=+3.4). Everything but the stair is blocking.

Arena set piece: a giant root of the World Tree arching out of the ash, a lower root looping in front on the right (12 x 4, crown 4.4 high; underside clearance ~2.5 between glTF x = -2 and 2). Níðhöggr's bite wounds show pale heartwood and drip soul sap (emissive_soul) into a glowing pool on the ground. Lichen, hanging dead moss (sways), rootlets, ash heaps. Blocking where it touches the ground (x < -3 and x > 3); the arch middle is passable.
Soul lantern: a bone post with a vertebra crossarm and skull, an iron cage lantern holding a pale green soul flame (emissive_soul), a strip of Hel's cloth (sways).
